user_requirements: Review a DRAFT Statement in Reply (STATEMENT_IN_REPLY.txt) prepared by SLS RTC Limited's employment lawyer for the NZ Employment Relations Authority, responding to Ryan Webby's claim. CASE_FACTS.txt gives context. This is the client (SLS RTC / Ahmad Duais) reviewing their lawyer's draft before it is filed on 21 August 2026. Your job: (1) FACTUAL ACCURACY & INTERNAL CONSISTENCY — flag every date/name/entity error or inconsistency; in particular check the employment-commencement date is stated consistently (it should be 12 March 2025 throughout — flag any place it says 2026), and flag 'SLC RTC' and any email-address typos. (2) OPEN BRACKETS — list every [bracketed] gap/question the lawyer has left for the client to answer, and for each say exactly what the client must provide (the pay-breakdown email; when records were provided to Ryan; the purpose of the 11 March meeting and why no support person; the 2 March Bunnings Riccarton 'discussed with staff first' point; the correct account of the 14 June complaint handling incl. the 14 July 'assumed another manager dealt with it'; the pay-review correspondence). (3) LEGAL SOUNDNESS (NZ ER) — assess whether the key defences are well-made: the 12 March 2025 start date rebutting pre-2025 claims; the s63A variation defeating the hours-reduction claim; the 90-day time-bar (s103(3)) arguments; the radio-shift-paid point defeating that disadvantage claim. Flag any defence that is weak, overstated, or unsupported by the facts. (4) EXPOSURE / RISK — identify where SLS is most exposed and where the draft's own wording concedes a problem (especially the failure-to-investigate-the-complaint claim and the records/Privacy Act supply), and what evidence SLS needs to hold to make each denial stick. (5) COMPLETENESS & TONE for an ERA pleading. Produce a severity-graded findings list (CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR) with exact current text and exact suggested text or the exact information required. Do NOT rewrite the pleading wholesale.
acquirer_context: Audience: the client (a security company director) checking his lawyer's draft ERA Statement in Reply before filing. The review must catch factual errors the client can correct, list precisely what the client must supply for each bracketed gap, and give an honest read of where the company is exposed. It is not a substitute for the lawyer's advice; it is a client-side sense-check + an action list.
